summary.title: Ruby on Rails Tutorial
summary.one_liner: A project-based book and screencast course, updated for Rails 8, that teaches you to build and deploy real web applications with Ruby on Rails.
keywords: learn ruby on rails for beginners
full stack web development with ruby
takeaways: The book is updated for Rails 8 and covers developing and deploying industrial-strength web applications.
The book is sold as an ebook in PDF, EPUB, and MOBI formats.
A companion screencast series has 14 lessons, one per book chapter.
The tutorial is also offered as a self-paced online course within the Learn Enough All Access subscription, with exercises and progress tracking.
The page lists a 7-day free trial, then a monthly subscription, and a 60-day money-back guarantee on Learn Enough tutorials.
summary.summary: This page promotes the Ruby on Rails Tutorial, a book and screencast series updated for Rails 8 that teaches building and deploying web applications with Ruby on Rails. It describes the book as available in ebook formats, the companion video series of 14 lessons, and an online self-paced course with exercises, streaming videos, and progress tracking. It also covers subscription terms within the Learn Enough All Access bundle, including a free trial and money-back guarantee. Most of the text is marketing, so pricing and trial details are not verified here.
